scope_notes: All samples, including warmup, retained. Wall timings vary with same-machine load; no frame budget or cross-run attribution.
Read samples at committed t1800. Input at t10. AUTO uses the same30s target cuts to1800.
Session input/advance/read timer spans overlap. Do not sum them. Python formatting excludes printing; demo CLI output timer includes printing.
Payload bytes describe serialized cache/receipts/timeline, not allocator RSS. One transport packet/response and fixed buffers are also retained.
Benchmark dispose internal timer can exclude deferred temporary-reference destruction. Quit-to-child-reaped wall includes destruction, shutdown and reader cleanup.
World construction, cleanup and explicit final audit may scale with sleepers. Look never calls audit or world_result. Diagnostics OFF.
